summary: Retested ONLY Bug 1 (Welcome Ride instant-complete) after the backend fix (backend/server.py TrainerSim.__init__ self.elapsed/self.distance changed from 1477.0/24.6 to 0.0/0.0, matching frontend useTelemetry.ts DEFAULTS). Confirmed the backend code change is in place and both backend+expo services show fresh restart uptimes. Ran 'Welcome Ride' (ctr-ride-1, 20 min / 1200s) via greenlantern@roujaune.app 3 FRESH times (localStorage/sessionStorage cleared before each attempt) navigating into the live workout screen: ALL 3 attempts now start at ELAPSED 0:00/0:01/0:02 and tick up normally (verified up to 0:14-0:17s of continuous ticking each time) with NO 'Workout Complete' modal appearing. This is a full reversal of the iteration_119 finding (which reproduced instant-complete 3/3 times pre-fix). Also verified a shorter/medium workout (FB50 Post-Ride Mobility, 18 min / 1080s -- no catalog entry existed under 10 min so used the shortest available) starts and ticks normally with no premature completion, and re-confirmed the previously-tested longer workout (Threshold Intervals Foundation, 34 min / 2040s) still starts and ticks normally (no regression). No backend errors observed in supervisor logs during any of the runs. Bug 1 is now VERIFIED FIXED.

design_issues.screen: Today screen (Home) 'From Couch to Road' plan card / NEXT WORKOUTS list, mobile viewport 390x844
issues: Pre-existing, unrelated to Bug 1: the plan summary card and 'NEXT WORKOUTS' list content overflow/renders vertically one-character-per-line in places (e.g. 'From Couch to Road', 'Beginner Cycling Strength'), and workout cards like 'Welcome Ride' inside this section render off-screen horizontally / partially outside the viewport making them unclickable via normal tap without scrolling into a hidden horizontal carousel. Had to use direct URL navigation (workoutId param) to reach the live workout screen for testing instead of tapping through the UI. This matches the /plan layout issue already flagged in iteration_119.json and appears to also affect the Today/Home screen's plan widget -- worth a wider look at this card's responsive layout on mobile.
